description: This source file defines interfaces and classes for configuring memory streams within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes extension methods for partitioning configuration, as well as separate configurators for silo and client contexts, supporting generic message body serializers.

classes.name: SiloMemoryStreamConfigurator`1
classes.description: A generic configurator class for silo memory streams, supporting a specified message serializer type.

classes.name: ClusterClientMemoryStreamConfigurator`1
classes.description: A generic configurator class for cluster client memory streams, supporting a specified message serializer type.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: An extension method to configure the number of queues for memory streams, with a default value.

methods.name: SiloMemoryStreamConfigurator`1.<init>
methods.description: Constructor initializing silo memory stream configurer with stream name and service configuration delegate.

methods.name: ClusterClientMemoryStreamConfigurator`1.<init>
methods.description: Constructor initializing cluster client memory stream configurer with stream name and client builder.
